name: apple-app-store-scraper
title: Apple App Store Scraper - Ratings, Prices & Versions
description: Compare iOS competitors for US app agencies: aggregate ratings, rating counts, versions, release dates, developer details and download prices. Look up known app IDs or official URLs in the US storefront and export CSV for client research. No API key required.

app-scraped.eventDescription: Charged for each validated Apple App Store metadata record saved to the dataset.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
